premises.text: Users cannot see, control, or secure the personal data corporations harvest from them
premises.evidence_span: the average user has no idea what data they're generating or who can see it, let alone how to actually secure their data

premises.text: Syncing Facebook/Google organizes personal data anonymized and encrypted
premises.evidence_span: Simply sync your platforms, like Facebook and Google, to see all of your personal data organized in simple categories, fully anonymized and encrypted

premises.text: Encrypted ML matches only data the user wants to share with targeted offers under user private keys
premises.evidence_span: Our patented technology encrypts your data and only you have the private key. Ozone then runs encrypted machine learning to match only the data you want to share with offers that are targeted for you

premises.text: Reverse subscription: approved companies pay for anonymized data subscriptions; users get monthly payments
premises.evidence_span: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data. For each subscription, you receive a monthly payment directly into your Venmo, PayPal, or bank account of your choice

premises.text: Businesses buy pre-approved audiences and pay for conversions not eyeballs
premises.evidence_span: companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions, not just eyeballs like on Facebook

value.text: User-controlled data with ability to reclaim monetization from big data
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you

secondary_value.text: Ethically sourced user-controlled data for companies
secondary_value.evidence_span: This is ethically sourced data that's controlled by the user

causal_links.evidence_span: companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data

notes: Merged freemium pay-for-conversions with advertiser audience offer as one commercial premise (§4.1.3). Patents not split (§4.1.1).
